medicines.uses: Relief of mild to moderate pain and fever.
medicines.seriousSideEffects: Liver damage (if taken in high doses), severe skin reactions.
medicines.storageInstructions: Store at room temperature away from moisture and heat.
medicines.beforeAfterFood: Can be taken with or without food.
medicines.pregnancyWarning: Generally safe, but consult a doctor.

medicines.uses: Prevention and treatment of scurvy, immune support.
medicines.commonSideEffects: Diarrhea, stomach cramps at high doses.
medicines.storageInstructions: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry place.

medicines.uses: Pain relief, inflammation, and heart attack prevention.
medicines.seriousSideEffects: Gastrointestinal bleeding, Reye's syndrome in children.
medicines.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place.
medicines.beforeAfterFood: Take with food or milk to avoid stomach upset.

interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination or monitor closely under medical supervision.
